hook: Catch the topic, the tip and the number in a radio-style interview, and ignore the teaser for next week's episode.
intro: A health podcast about stress, heard once: the presenter and her guest, the doctor Jonas Fischer, in a short interview of about 200 words. Radio and podcast interviews like this follow a predictable pattern, and so do the questions here: the topic (Heute geht es um …), the causes (weil sie zu viel arbeiten und zu wenig schlafen), the advice in the formal imperative (Machen Sie …, Schalten Sie … aus), a number (zwanzig Minuten), an effect described in the passive (beim Sport wird Stress abgebaut) and a correction of a common belief (Muss es Joggen sein? – Nein, gar nicht). Listen for the signals the podcast gives you — Heute geht es um, Unser Tipp:, Schon … reichen — and for the last sentence, which names the next episode’s topic: a typical distractor.
tips[0].title: Heute geht es um … = the topic
tips[0].text: The first question is nearly always the topic, and the podcast announces it. The next episode’s topic is often mentioned at the end — as a trap.
tips[0].check.why: Heute geht es um … names today's topic; the next episode's topic at the end is the trap.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: Topic
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Guest
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Tip
tips[0].visual.moves[3].label: Teaser
tips[1].title: Unser Tipp: + imperative
tips[1].text: The advice question is answered by the formal imperatives after Unser Tipp: Machen Sie …, gehen Sie …, Schalten Sie … aus, treiben Sie Sport.
tips[1].check.why: The advice comes straight after Unser Tipp: as imperatives: Trinken Sie viel …, essen Sie wenig …
tips[2].title: Numbers and corrections
tips[2].text: After schon comes a small amount that is enough: Schon zwanzig Minuten am Tag reichen. After Nein, gar nicht comes the correction of what someone assumed.
tips[2].check.why: Nein, gar nicht rejects the gym, and after schon comes the small amount that is enough: zehn Minuten zu Hause.
remember[0]: Topic after "geht es um"; advice after "Unser Tipp"; the amount after "schon".
remember[1]: The next episode’s topic at the end is a distractor.
exam: Radio-style interviews like this podcast are a standard listening text in the B1 exam — and on your commute.
tips[1].check.q: „Unser Tipp: Trinken Sie viel Wasser und essen Sie wenig Zucker.“ What is the advice?
tips[1].check.options[0]: Drink plenty of water and eat little sugar.
tips[1].check.options[1]: Drink less water and eat more sugar.
tips[1].check.options[2]: Eat sugar instead of drinking water.
tips[1].check.answer: Drink plenty of water and eat little sugar.
tips[2].check.q: „Muss man dafür ins Fitnessstudio? – Nein, gar nicht. Schon zehn Minuten Gymnastik zu Hause reichen.“ What is enough?
tips[2].check.options[0]: ten minutes of exercise at home
tips[2].check.answer: ten minutes of exercise at home
